records.Name: Northeast Broadband Degradation
records.Summary__c: Customers in the Northeast may experience slower broadband speeds and intermittent streaming buffering. Mobile voice and text are unaffected. Engineers have identified a faulty core router and are deploying a fix.

records.Name: Bay Area Mobile Data Outage
records.Summary__c: A mobile data outage affecting the Bay Area has been mitigated. Most customers should see service restored; we are monitoring for stability. Voice, text, and broadband are unaffected.

records.Name: London Streaming Investigation
records.Summary__c: We are investigating reports of Nimbus streaming failures in the London region. Broadband and mobile services are operating normally. No confirmed cause yet.

records.Name: Midwest Fiber Cut (Resolved)
records.Summary__c: A fiber cut affecting broadband in the Midwest has been fully repaired and all services restored.
